en: A model in a red dress walks along a narrow catwalk between two rows of seated spectators.

prompt:
Subject: catwalk, target meaning "細長いステージ".

Composition: A model walks along a narrow raised catwalk between two rows of seated spectators, keeping the runway's length visible.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded 2D shapes, smooth solid colors and restrained cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep every part inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
